_comment: Merge these entries into the atrex Claude settings.json (usually <install-base>/.claude/settings.json, or ~/.claude/settings.json). They ADD a Stop (and optional SubagentStop) hook that runs the non-blocking kernel-experience extractor ALONGSIDE atrex's own gpu-kernel-optimizer hook. Keep both. The `_tag` marks these as ours for later removal. Replace <MEMORY_SKILL_DIR> with the absolute path to this memory-skill directory.
